messages:
Emma: Hey folks, hopping into the Vancouver office next week. Looking for sushi to-go near Yaletown for a late-ish lunch. Any go-to spots that do reliable takeout (no reservations)? 
Carlos: Miku is great for aburi nigiri but pricier and can be a wait. They do takeout though.
Priya: For quick and decent rolls, Sushi Bar Maumi on Mainland is solid. Cheap, fast, good for teams.
Ben: Salmon sushi at Toshi Sushi (Davie) is surprisingly good and usually ready fast.
Mei: If you want something more casual + fast: Guu Garden has decent takeout bento boxes. Also love the onigiri at Onigiriya.
Carlos: Note: weekends Yaletown streets get packed. Best to order ~20-30 min ahead.
Emma: Can you drop a quick address list? Helps with Maps.
Priya: Sure: 
```
Miku Restaurant 33 70 Canada Place Way (waterfront, pricier)
Sushi Bar Maumi 33 1202 Mainland St
Toshi Sushi 33 1208 Davie St
Guu Garden 33 1698 Robson St
Onigiriya 33 1111 Mainland St
```
Ben: Pro tip: if you need kid-friendly/less raw, Maumi has cooked tempura rolls that are crowd-pleasers.
Mei: Also FYI: some places close around 3pm between lunch/dinner. If you need 2pm pickup likely ok.
Emma: Amazing, thank you all! Quick poll: who wants to join a group order Wednesday 12:30? :thumbsup: yes, :raised_hand: maybe, :x: nope
Carlos: :thumbsup:
Priya: :raised_hand:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Mei: :x: (doctor appt)
Emma: I'll queue an order for Sushi Bar Maumi at 12:15 and post pickup ETA. Anyone got dietary flags?
Priya: Vegetarian here 12; can do veg roll.
Carlos: No shells for me (allergy).
OpsBot: Reminder set 33 "YVR group sushi order" Wed 12:15 in #lunch-plans.
Emma: Cool, will DM payment details later. See y'all next week!
